apps.name: CleanCut
apps.shortDescription: Privately mute profanity and convert video files on Mac or Windows. Mac also includes subtitles and batch processing.
apps.longDescription: CleanCut cleans up videos on-device without uploading source media. Mac includes profanity muting, SRT or embedded subtitles, MP4 conversion, and batch processing. Windows early access includes profanity muting and MP4 conversion for individual videos.
apps.trial: Mac: 3 completed videos free; Windows: installer after purchase
apps.license: Mac: one activated computer with deactivation before moving Macs. Windows: paid-download early access; in-app activation is planned.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.delivery: Private Polar file-download benefit after purchase

demo.summary: Watch CleanCut turn a rough video into a clean copy without uploading the file.

notes: CleanCut has its own product page at cleancut.html; the home page showcases all public apps.
Marketing focus shifted toward private video cleanup for files people already have before sharing.
Website promises 14-day refund help for buyers whose setup does not work.
Windows 1.0.43 is delivered as a private Polar file-download benefit attached to CleanCut One-Time; it does not yet enforce in-app license activation.
Do not reuse CleanCut's Polar IDs, bundle ID, release repo, or app storage keys for another app.

apps.name: PolishKey
apps.shortDescription: Rewrite selected text from a desktop hotkey, local by default with optional Gemini support.
apps.longDescription: PolishKey rewrites selected text in place using one private local model by default. Friendly, Professional, and Custom modes work across messages, emails, documents, forms, notes, and everyday writing, with a provider-aware Off, On, or Smart thinking control for local AI and the optional bring-your-own-key Gemini provider.
apps.license: One activated computer; customers can deactivate before moving machines.

demo.summary: Watch PolishKey turn a rough selected note into a polished reply without leaving your keyboard.

notes: PolishKey uses bundle ID com.envelopes.polishkey.
Do not reuse CleanCut's Polar IDs, bundle ID, release repo, checkout URL, license benefit, app-storage keys, or download assets.
Apple Silicon Mac release v0.2.41 is signed, notarized, stapled, and published from the PolishKey-specific updates repo.
Version 0.2.33 adds a guarded optional Gemini provider, explicit selected-text rewrite framing, Gemini thinking config, thought-part filtering, and source-loss fallback protection.

Version 0.2.34 upgrades Balanced/Careful local quality to qwen3:4b-instruct models, adds automatic Gemini daily-quota fallback to the local engine with automatic recovery, blocks unsafe hotkeys like Cmd+C, and allows single function-key hotkeys.
Version 0.2.35 replaces the local quality tiers with one on-demand Gemma 4 12B model and adds one shared Off, On, or Smart thinking control for local and Gemini rewrites.
Version 0.2.36 keeps Thinking On and complex Smart rewrites available by falling back to Gemini 2.5 with thinking when Gemini 3.5 is temporarily overloaded.
Version 0.2.37 keeps local Smart and automatic cloud fallback responsive, restores the reliable macOS shortcut, and adds privacy-safe rewrite diagnostics.
Version 0.2.38 restores Option+Space support and fixes recording Option-modified keys on macOS.
Version 0.2.39 identifies Gemini Cloud and Local AI directly in the hotkey progress bubble and retries Gemini after brief rate-limit cooldowns instead of disabling cloud use for the rest of the day.
Version 0.2.40 keeps the provider name visible through the full hotkey workflow with unmistakably different Gemini Cloud and Local AI progress designs.
Version 0.2.41 adds a direct Google AI Studio key link and simple setup guidance beneath the Gemini API key field.
A real purchase, activation, deactivation, and license move test is still recommended before larger paid promotion.

apps.name: Envelopes
apps.shortDescription: A simple envelope budgeting app for iPhone and iPad that helps you give every dollar a job without linking your bank.
apps.longDescription: Envelopes is a zero-based envelope budgeting app for people who want a clear plan without bank-linking or financial noise. Create accounts and envelopes, assign real money to the jobs it needs to do, log spending, plan bills, and optionally sync through an Envelopes account.
apps.license: Auto-renewable App Store subscription unlocks full native iOS access after the trial.

demo.summary: See the Envelopes budget, calendar, and account screens from the live App Store listing.

notes: Bundle ID is com.envelopes.app.
App Store product ID is 6782375480.
Subscriptions are envelopes_monthly ($2.99/month) and envelopes_annual ($24.99/year), both with a 14-day free trial.
Do not reuse CleanCut or PolishKey Polar IDs, license rules, release assets, storage keys, or bundle IDs.
The public sales path is the App Store listing.
